subject: Novus Health - Discovery recap & Pilot launchpad (scope, owners, access)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Cara Nguyen <cara@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Novus discovery — recap + pilot launchpad proposal

Hi Cara — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed launchpad for the pilot so your team can review with procurement/IT. Keeping this short and action-oriented.

Top pain points we heard
- Clinical documentation review currently manual; average triage time 18–24 hours.
- High false-positive rate on suggested coding edits (~27%) causing extra QA cycles.
- Model latency and cost sensitivity — production SLO target is median latency <250ms and predictability under budget.

Pilot goals (30 days)
1) Reduce triage time by 30% for inbound notes (measure: median processing time).
2) Improve coding suggestion precision by 15 points on our prompt-eval set (measure: prompt_evals/results.csv).
3) Validate cost per 1k tokens at your workload distribution under $X (TBD once we see sample load).

Suggested pilot scope
- Dataset: de-identified sample set (10k notes) loaded to a secured S3 bucket under Novus account; sample manifest: s3://novus-redwood/pilot-manifest.csv
- Model: Redwood-hosted v1.3 (quantized variant) with KV caching enabled
- Eval: Prompt set of 120 prompts (we'll run baseline + two prompt variants)
- Duration: 30 days (1-week setup, 3-week evaluation)

Owners / roles
- Novus: Cara Nguyen (Product lead), IT Security (for allowlist + KMS), Procurement (PO)
- Redwood: Kimberly Park (SE lead), Ben Carter (Eng ops), Marissa Cole (Customer Success)

Access / setup asks
1) Add redwood@novus-health.svc to your allowlist (IPs and subnets included in linked doc).
2) Create a scoped S3 bucket or presigned upload endpoint for the de-id dataset and share the manifest link.
3) Confirm whether Novus will provide KMS keys (preferred) or we will use Redwood-managed keys.
4) Procurement: If you can review PO template (attached) and send any redlines, we can start contract steps in parallel.

Deliverables
- Mutual action plan (attached) with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria
- Prompt/eval results report at day 21 and final summary at day 30

Attachments: Novus_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx; PO_Template_Redwood.docx; security_questionnaire_novus_signed.pdf

Next steps (for this week)
- Cara: Confirm dataset owner and timeline for providing the de-id sample (by Wed 30 Jul).
- Procurement: Let us know procurement contact and any PO timing constraints.
- IT Security: Provide allowlist window and KMS choice.

Happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if helpful — propose Wed 30 Jul 9:00–9:30 PT.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Cara Nguyen <cara@novushealth.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>, IT Security <it-security@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 17:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novus discovery — recap + pilot launchpad proposal

Kimberly — this is great, thank you for the clear summary. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Dataset: We can pull a 10k de-id sample. ETA from data engineering: EOD Fri 1 Aug. We'll share a presigned link.
- KMS: IT prefers Novus-managed KMS keys; I'll loop them in.
- Allowlist: IT will need the exact IPs and a 2-hour maintenance window for the initial setup — cc'd them.
- Procurement: I copied procurement — they will review the PO template and revert with redlines/lead time.

On metrics: the 30% triage reduction target feels ambitious but worth testing — we'll accept the pilot acceptance criteria as written for the initial run.

Confirming Wed 30 Jul 9:00 PT works for me and my product manager. We'll be there.

Thanks,
Cara Nguyen
Director, Data Science | Novus Health
cara@novushealth.com | (650) 555-0199

Thanks Cara — appreciate the quick alignment. Short setup checklist and who owns what (so we can start Monday):

Checklist (items to complete before initial run)
- Novus (Data Eng): Share presigned S3 manifest + sample files (Due: Fri 2025-08-01)
- Novus (IT Security): Provide KMS ARN or confirm Redwood-managed keys; provide allowlist window and any egress constraints (Due: Fri 2025-08-01)
- Procurement: Review PO template and confirm expected lead time / redlines (Due: Fri 2025-08-01)
- Redwood (Kimberly/Ben): Provision pilot environment, generate scoped API key, and share integration quickstart doc (Due: Mon 2025-08-04)
- Redwood (Marissa): Schedule prompt-eval baseline run and ensure eval harness has Novus metrics instrumented (Due: Mon 2025-08-11)

Acceptance criteria (to be validated at day 21)
- Median triage time decreased >= 30% vs baseline
- Precision uplift on coding suggestions >= +15 points on the agreed prompt set
- Cost estimate validated — cost per 1k tokens within target (TBD after baseline run)

Attachments referenced: Mutual action plan (milestones + owners). I've attached an updated MAP with concrete dates and a first-cut rollup of responsibilities.

If procurement needs pre-approved wording on data handling, we can provide our standard SOC2/KMS clauses and a short security brief — I attached the signed questionnaire from today for their review.

I'll calendar the 09:00 PT follow-up for Wed 30 Jul — invite coming from Marissa.

Best,
Kimberly
